lines.text: The LORD tells Saul through Samuel to attack the Amalekites, and Saul numbers his troops at Telaim.
Saul warns the Kenites to leave, strikes down the Amalekites, and captures Agag alive but spares the best animals.
The LORD regrets making Saul king, so Samuel finds Saul and asks about the trumpets blowing in the camp.

wrong_details.true: bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle

lines.text: Saul says the troops spared animals to sacrifice, but Samuel says obedience is better and the LORD rejected Saul.
After Saul confesses, Samuel hacks Agag to pieces at Gilgal, goes to Ramah, and Saul goes home to Mizpah.
